description: Convert CSV/TSV to JSON with an RFC 4180 parser (quoted fields, "" escapes, line breaks inside quotes, CR/LF/CRLF, BOM). Detects the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), uses the first row as headers (blank → column_N, duplicates → name_2), and can type values (numbers, true/false, null; long digit strings like IDs stay strings). Output: array of objects or array of arrays, pretty-printed. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/csv-json/

header.description: First row is a header (default true).

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a CSV/TSV file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

shape.description: "objects" (one object per row) or "arrays" (rows as arrays).

types.description: Turn numbers, true/false and empty/null into JSON types (default true).

name: csv_to_json
title: CSV to JSON
